2754.title: Desktop browser rejects popups that need opener access
2754.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop browser sends every allowed new-window URL to an application tab and always returns deny.

prReviews.topFinding: The static diff separates request classes and hardens native child windows; this report did not execute the branch.

2754.proposedFix: Separate blank-target tabs from named or sized native popups, and enforce the existing hardened session policy on each child window.
2754.caveats: The direct unit test reproduced the exact handler defect twice. This report did not run a live OAuth service or the linked pull request.
